_note: Read-only snapshot of BAM GTA as production actually holds it: the clients row PLUS every automation and every step. It is the ONE source of truth for 'what GTA looks like today' - scripts/render-messages.mjs renders from it, api/_gta-message-lock.test.mjs builds its client fixture from it, and api/_gta-step-lock.test.mjs locks the rendered step bodies from it, so a production change cannot be true for one and stale for another. Only fields that exist on the row belong here: an absent field must stay absent, because clientVars() treats absent as 'this academy has no such fact'.
_captured: 2026-07-28, straight from production (clients + automations + automation_steps for client 39875f07-0a4b-4429-a201-2249bc1f24df). The previous version of this file was hand-abridged: it truncated brand_data, dropped website_setup down to the domain, omitted the missed_trial / trial_form / summer_special automations entirely, showed onboarding as 3 steps when production has 8, and had already been edited to the PROPOSED tokenized ghosted bodies rather than the live ones. A fixture that drifts from production passes for the wrong reason. Re-capture whenever a production column or a GTA message row changes.

brand_data.story: By Any Means started in the GTA with one mission: give serious young hoopers the coaching, reps and accountability that actually move the needle. What began as small-group sessions near Oakville has grown into a training program families across the region trust to develop real game.
brand_data.why_us: We coach with a plan, not just drills. Small groups, honest feedback, and a clear path for every athlete from where they are to where they want to be. Parents see the progress on the court and in the numbers.
brand_data.references: Happy with the current site - keep the look
brand_data.dream_athletes: Ages 9 to 17, driven and coachable. The player chasing a rep spot or varsity minutes, and the family that treats development like it matters. Effort first, everything else follows.
